test_title: PYST 01: SSC JE ME - General Intelligence (Held on 05 Jun 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A # B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the father of B’

Based on the above, how is E related to M if ‘E # F × H @ G + M’?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 #
 @
 ×
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Brother
 Father
 Wife
 
 

Given: E # F × H @ G + M

It means: E is the Brother of F, F is the Wife of H, H is the Father of G, G is the Sister of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/170e7a6ae85799f44fe0602d8c0fd126aac9c7195dd37f7a7c73cccacf3397cc.png] 

So, E is the '**Mother's Brother**' of M.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Mother’s brother"**.
